The '''Variable Altitude Assault Transport/ enforcement (VAAT/e)''', also known as the '''Coruscant Police assault ship''', was a predecessor to the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] used primarily by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] as a rapid troop deployment platform.<ref name="BHPG" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:DemolitionBombard.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A VAAT/e owned by the [[Galactic Vacant Building Demolitions]] company bombarding an abandoned home]]

It was manufactured by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] and measured 25 meters in length, 7 meters in height, and had a wingspan measuring 25 meters. Its cargo capacity was about 36 cubic meters in the main hold, and it could carry about 15 troops and 1 [[IM-6 Battlefield Medical Droid/Legends|IM-6 battlefield medical droid]].

Its crew consisted of one pilot, one copilot/gunner, and two auxiliary turret gunners. It was armed with a [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] launcher and two dual heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] turrets.

==History==
A VAAT/e was used against [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] after he assassinated [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Connus Trell]].<ref name="Bounter Hunter">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], this vehicle was used by [[Galactic Vacant Building Demolitions]] to destroy abandoned buildings in low-orbit aerial bombardment, using [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]].<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>
